metadata.description: Grid of 3×3 metamer pairs per observer. Generated in DISP space (RGBO) using observer-specific ColorSpace, then converted to BGYR for storage. Sampled using ColorSampler on cube face 4 at luminance=1.0, saturation=0.5
metadata.method: ColorSampler.get_metameric_pairs() in DISP space, converted to BGYR via ColorSpace.convert()
